faq.question: How fast can they turn around a demand package?
faq.answer: Turnaround depends on case complexity and record volume, but most standard PI demand packages are completed within **3–5 business days** of receiving complete records. Complex cases with significant medical history may take longer — we set clear expectations upfront.

faq.question: What do they need to get started on a case?
faq.answer: Typically: access to the case file in your case management system, complete medical records and bills, your demand letter template, and any specific instructions from the attorney. We make it easy — **just assign the case and they take it from there**.

faq.question: Will the letters match my firm's voice and format?
faq.answer: Yes — your specialist is trained on your templates, formatting preferences, and tone during onboarding. Every draft is built to your standard so your attorneys only need to **review and approve, not rewrite**.

faq.question: Is there a contract or minimum commitment?
faq.answer: We have a service agreement but **no long-term lock-in**. You can exit at any time with no penalties. Our results are what keeps clients with us — not the fine print.

faq.question: What if the quality doesn't meet our standards?
faq.answer: Tell us and we'll address it immediately — either through additional training or by **matching you with a different specialist at no extra cost**. Quality that meets your firm's standard is the baseline, not the bonus.
